modelOverview: Launched at Baselworld 2014, the Nautilus 5990 combines a flyback chronograph with Patek Philippe's Travel Time dual time-zone mechanism, making it the most complicated steel Nautilus of its era. Two pushers set into the left flank of the case advance or retard the local-time hour hand, with twin day/night apertures and an analogue date linked to local time, while the self-winding Calibre CH 28-520 C FUS drives a column-wheel, vertical-clutch chronograph with a 60-minute counter at 6 o'clock. The original black-gradient steel 5990/1A-001 ran from 2014 until 2021; it was joined by an 18k rose gold 5990/1R-001 in 2021 and succeeded in steel by the blue-grey 5990/1A-011 in 2022.

5990/1A-011.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre CH 28-520 C FUS · 28,800 vph · 45–55h power reserve
5990/1A-011.materials: Stainless steel case and integrated bracelet with patented fold-over clasp and lockable adjustment system
5990/1A-011.bezel: Steel rounded-octagonal Nautilus bezel with contrasting polished and satin-brushed finishes
5990/1A-011.dial: Sunburst blue-grey dial with black-gradient rim and horizontal embossing, white gold applied baton hour markers with luminescent coating; 60-minute chronograph counter and date at 6 o'clock, day/night apertures at 3 and 9 o'clock, skeletonised home-time hour hand
5990/1A-011.description: The 5990/1A-011 is the current steel Nautilus Travel Time Chronograph, replacing the black-dial 5990/1A-001 in 2022 with a blue-grey sunburst dial that shades to black at the rim. It retains the flyback chronograph, dual time zones with day/night indication and local-date display of the original, driven by the 370-part Calibre CH 28-520 C FUS visible through the sapphire caseback. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

5990/1R-001.description: Introduced in 2021, the 5990/1R-001 was the first Nautilus Travel Time Chronograph in precious metal, pairing a full 18k rose gold case and bracelet with a sunburst blue dial and rose gold markers. Mechanically it is identical to the steel model, with the flyback chronograph, dual time-zone pushers at 9 o'clock and local-date display of the Calibre CH 28-520 C FUS. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.
